changes.before: अभी लगभग एक मीटर छोटा करूँगा। कुत्ते को खुलकर दौड़ाने की जगह है?
changes.after: अभी पट्टे को छोटा करके उसकी लंबाई लगभग एक मीटर रखूँगा। क्या कुत्ते को खुलकर दौड़ाने की कोई जगह है?
changes.reason: Japanese specifies shortening the leash TO approximately one metre, not shortening BY one metre; preserve resultant length and free-run question.

changes.before: Trước khi đến xem đã nhận chưa, tôi sẽ nhờ gửi bằng cách tra được qua mã số.
changes.after: Trước khi đến xem hàng đã tới chưa, tôi sẽ nhờ người gửi chọn cách gửi có thể tra cứu bằng mã số.
changes.reason: The Japanese asks whether the parcel has arrived at the post office before visiting, rather than whether it has already been received by the customer.

changes.before: Anh/chị trả vào nơi để xe đẩy ở cửa ra. Có thể đẩy xe không quay lại.
changes.after: Anh/chị trả xe đẩy vào khu để xe đẩy ở cửa ra nhé. Anh/chị có thể đẩy xe trống quay lại.
changes.reason: Clarify empty cart returns to exit storage; the old phrase xe không quay lại could be read as not returning the cart, reversing the action.

changes.before: 丢失钓具的申报里，想改持有人栏。其实是从店里借的。
changes.after: 我想修改丢失钓具申报中的所有者一栏。其实这些钓具是从店里借来的。
changes.reason: The corrected field is the owner, not the current holder; distinguishing shop ownership from borrower possession is the core task.

changes.before: 遺失釣具的申報裡，想改持有人欄。其實是從店裡借的。

changes.reason: The corrected field is the owner, not the current holder; distinguishing shop ownership from borrower possession is the core task.

changes.before: From Monday through the following Wednesday. I will be home Wednesday night.
changes.after: From Monday through Wednesday of the following week. I will return home on Wednesday night.
changes.reason: Explicitly retain Wednesday of the following week, not the Wednesday immediately after Monday, matching the stated roughly ten-day absence.
